How about this low-level booty pouch? Someday, when you're qualified to open it, you'll have the strongest armor available! Bring me a Buffalo Horn and I…

links.text: "I'd like one of the Ketra's specialty products."

ai/npc/KetraOrcSupport/31375-02.html.text: Trader Jumara: Tejakar Ketra! Welcome, dear friend! I've been ordered to supply a higher-level pouch to you, but you won't get the strongest armor yet! Try again when you've had more experiences. Bring me a Buffalo Horn and I'll give you whatever you want. Care to take a look?

links.text: "I'd like one of the Ketra's specialty products."

ai/npc/KetraOrcSupport/31375-03.html.text: Trader Jumara: Tejakar Ketra! Welcome, dear friend! You're finally qualified to get the most valuable looted goods from our tribe! Now, open the box that holds the strongest armor! Bring me a Buffalo Horn and I'll give you anything you want!

links.text: "I'd like one of the Ketra's specialty products."

ai/npc/KetraOrcSupport/31375-no.html.text: Trader Jumara: I don't deal with foreigners! Get lost, you filthy invader!
